WITH siparis_tutarlar AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id as siparis_id,
        s.musteri_id,
        m.sehir,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) as tutar
    FROM siparisler s
    JOIN musteriler m ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.musteri_id, m.sehir
),
sehir_islemler AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        COUNT(*) as siparis_sayisi,
        AVG(tutar) as ortalama_tutar
    FROM siparis_tutarlar
    GROUP BY sehir
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
rankli AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        siparis_sayisi,
        tutar,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sehir ORDER BY tutar ASC) as rank_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sehir ORDER BY tutar DESC) as rank_desc
    FROM siparis_tutarlar
),
median_hesapla AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        AVG(tutar) as medyan
    FROM rankli
    WHERE (rank_asc + rank_desc) IN (
        SELECT siparis_sayisi * 2, (siparis_sayisi * 2) + 1
        FROM sehir_islemler
    )
    GROUP BY sehir
)
SELECT 
    si.sehir,
    si.siparis_sayisi,
    ROUND(mh.medyan, 2) as medyan
FROM sehir_islemler si
JOIN median_hesapla mh ON si.sehir = mh.sehir
ORDER BY mh.medyan DESC, si.sehir ASC;
